program = '''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    line_counts = Counter(color for _, color in row_lines + col_lines if color != background)
    if not line_counts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = line_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r, color in row_lines if color == divider]
    cols = [c for c, color in col_lines if color == divider]

    row_edges = [-1] + rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1)]
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != background
                                           for r in range(p[0], p[1])
                                           for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    pattern = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for pr0, pr1, pc0, pc1 in panels:
        for dr in range(pr1 - pr0):
            out[pr0 + dr][pc0:pc1] = pattern[dr][:pc1-pc0]
    return out
'''
